title: CandidateRule
description: The validated and compiled candidate rule produced by the Platform from a blue_proposal. It is what match_set.candidate_ref points to (candidate_id). It records the rule that was executed, never its results: matches travel in a separate match_set (role=candidate) and the decision in judge_result. It must not contain matches, labels, metrics or a verdict.

candidate_id.description: Unique id of this candidate. Referenced by match_set.candidate_ref.

proposal_id.description: proposal_id of the blue_proposal this candidate was built from.

base_rule_version.description: Must equal the rule_version of the baseline match_set.

candidate_rule_version.description: Must equal the rule_version of the candidate match_set.

applied_edit_count.description: Number of blue_proposal edits applied (bounded like blue_proposal.edits).

text.description: The exact compiled search that Splunk executes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of compiled_rule.text, for audit and reproducibility.

validation.description: Outcome of Platform schema/scope/permission/compile checks. Rejected proposals are reported as error_response and never become a candidate_rule.
